bio: Ruthos has no memory of where She came from – no memory before he heard Her voice. He was a knight, perhaps. Perhaps a soldier. He doesn’t worry about it, much. He has Her. She will show him the way. She knows best. She serves Serenity, and he serves Her, and nothing else matters. Nothing ever will.
